summary: This document defines iSCSI Extensions for RDMA, which provide RDMA data transfer capability to iSCSI by layering it on an RDMA-capable protocol. RDMA read and write services let data move directly into SCSI I/O buffers.

eli5.summary: Normally data is carried by a courier who hands it to a helper first. Here data is dropped directly into the right shelf without the extra handoffs.
